entities.summary: Ibrahim Muhawi is a Palestinian academic and writer, specializing in Palestinian and Arabic literature, folklore and translation. He is a member of the Palestinian diaspora. Ibrahim Muhawi was a journalists & chroniclers from Ramallah (b. 1937, Ramallah). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
